title: Understanding the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.06438v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization mechanism remains theoretically underexplored. We study CoT as compositional OOD generalization: the target task lacks complete reasoning trajectories or direct input-output pairs, while training provides only in-distribution (ID) atomic step data. We show that CoT generalizes by repeatedly applying a shared single-step predictor to compose reusable ID transitions. Theoretically, let $T$ denote the number of reasoning steps in the target task, $n$ the number of training samples per sub-task, and $k$ the number of output tokens per step; then the OOD task risk is controlled by the sum of the ID sub-task risks, scaled by a coefficient of order $\mathcal{O}(k)$ that is independent of $T$, although the summed risk itself may still grow with $T$. translated_title: 理解大语言模型中思维链推理的分布外泛化机制
translated_abstract: 思维链推理显著提升了大语言模型的表现，但其分布外（OOD）泛化机制在理论上仍未被充分探索。我们将思维链视为组合式分布外泛化问题来研究：目标任务缺乏完整的推理轨迹或直接的输入-输出对，而训练数据仅提供分布内（ID）的原子步骤数据。我们证明思维链通过反复应用一个共享的单步预测器来组合可复用的分布内转换，从而实现泛化。在理论上，设 $T$ 表示目标任务中的推理步数，$n$ 表示每个子任务的训练样本数，$k$ 表示每步的输出 token 数，则分布外任务的风险由分布内子任务风险之和控制，其缩放系数为 $\mathcal{O}(k)$ 量级且与 $T$ 无关，尽管该风险之和本身仍可能随 $T$ 增长。基于 Rademacher 复杂度的分析进一步表明，该估计（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文首次从理论上将大语言模型的思维链推理建模为组合式分布外泛化问题，证明其通过复用共享的单步预测器组合分布内原子转换来实现泛化，且分布外风险由分布内子任务风险之和乘以一个与推理步数无关的 $\mathcal{O}(k)$ 系数所控制。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first theoretical account of chain-of-thought reasoning in LLMs as compositional out-of-distribution generalization, showing that CoT generalizes by reusing a shared single-step predictor to compose in-distribution transitions, with OOD risk controlled by the sum of ID sub-task risks scaled by a coefficient of order O(k) that is independent of the number of reasoning steps.
